title: Sections of a directed colimit of sheaves of sets over a quasi-compact open (Stacks 009F)
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $I$ a directed set (nonempty, every two elements have a common upper bound), and $(\mathcal F_i,\varphi_{i'i}:\mathcal F_i\to\mathcal F_{i'})_{i\le i'}$ a system of sheaves of sets on $X$ over $I$ ($\varphi_{ii}=\mathrm{id}$, $\varphi_{i''i'}\varphi_{i'i}=\varphi_{i''i}$), with a colimit $(\mathcal F,(c_i:\mathcal F_i\to\mathcal F)_i)$ in the category of sheaves of sets on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For an open $U\subseteq X$ let $\Psi_U:\varinjlim_i\mathcal F_i(U)\to\mathcal F(U)$ be the map from the directed colimit of the sets $\mathcal F_i(U)$ (along the maps $\varphi_{i'i,U}$) whose restriction to the $i$-th term is $c_{i,U}$. Then: (1) if $U$ is quasi-compact, $\Psi_U$ is injective: if $s\in\mathcal F_i(U)$, $s'\in\mathcal F_{i'}(U)$ and $c_{i,U}(s)=c_{i',U}(s')$, then $\varphi_{i''i,U}(s)=\varphi_{i''i',U}(s')$ for some $i''\ge i,i'$; (2) if $U$ has a cofinal system of open coverings $U=\bigcup_{j\in J}U_j$ with $J$ finite and $U_j\cap U_{j'}$ quasi-compact for all $j,j'\in J$ (cofinal: every open covering of $U$ is refined by a covering of the system, i.e. each member of the latter lies in some member of the former), then $\Psi_U$ is bijective: moreover every $t\in\mathcal F(U)$ is $c_{i,U}(s)$ for some $i$ and $s\in\mathcal F_i(U)$.
